propositions: Plan-review findings are re-surfaced on subsequent reviews via a recall mechanism that injects prior findings with hardcoded empty evidence and blank impact, causing them to re-verify and re-qualify for recall indefinitely regardless of whether the underlying plan change addressed them.

A recalled finding loses its original evidence list during injection into the candidate and reappears with an empty-evidence signature on every round, creating a self-perpetuating ratchet that blocks convergence of the revise-review loop.

Pass-2 verification cannot act as a backstop because the evidence-empty injected candidate has no grounding to test, and the absence-veto logic fails to search the current plan text for refuting provisions that may address the finding.

The fix re-grounds recalled findings by carrying forward the prior finding's persisted evidence and impact, suppresses recall for prior findings with no persisted evidence, and gates recall on matching material fingerprints between prior and current sidecars.
